objective:
Build CTO Relay Station A1: complete Agent-facing public-project continuation, root Foundry contracts plus Node SDK/CLI, local tests, independent review and repairs. Local test deployments required; no public-chain deployment, frontend, live paid tests, paid child jobs, real credentials, autonomous spending, token launch, governance, ranking or treasury. Actual files, multi-assets and historical forks belong in A1.

SIX FUNCTIONS: anyone creates project/root Branch with fixed public goal; proposes work; explicitly sponsors a nonzero proposal; reads files/state/history; continues; forks accepted history. Creation/proposal/fork never implicitly buys AI. No two-round limit. Proposal binds current anchor, profile, target assetKey, selected input keys, output mapping, text and publish choice. Sponsors cannot replace them. Reject stale/conflicting/invalid purchases before collecting IMD. Adding a proposal cannot change execution anchor or invalidate other current proposals; any current proposal is selectable, without FIFO.

AUTHORITY: Factory registers fixed nonupgradeable Branch code, atomically initialized with immutable encoder/verifier/profiles. No operator setters, admin edits or arbitrary request/skill/payment entrypoint. Branch is IMD payer; root/child first runs use job.open@job-1, later runs job.continue@job-1 with own latest bound job. Child starts without own project/head. Never pass repoUrl/baseCommit or parent's projectId to continue.

INTAKE: official intake-client protocol, not its mutable-owner tutorial. Ethereum Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82; IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7. Runtime priceOf(action,asset), sponsor maxFee, exact transfer/approval, requestWithFailure, clear leftover allowance. Authenticate fixed Intake, own outstanding request and target/selector. Small callbacks record digest/phase only; no parsing/download/binding/new work. Reentrancy/state guards required.

FAILURES: if no callback arrives, remain pending indefinitely. Refused status 1 allows only explicit funded retry of identical body/snapshot/proposal with new attempt receipt; no parent/text/file substitution. Status 2 or unknown failure freezes purchases. Failed attempts are not revisions. No timeout unlock, automatic refund/retry, admin repair or HTTP settlement. Bad binding preserves recorded result/old checkpoint; anyone can resubmit correct binding without buying AI.

BINDING: exact raw manifest plus bounded old-asset witness; verify callback keccak256, complete JSON/completion/job/project identity and unique declared accepted files[] output. Never reserialize JSON or substitute source[]/later Git metadata. Strict UTF-8/escapes; reject decoded duplicate keys, trailing data, bad Unicode/paths and excessive depth/count/length. Preserve name,path,hash,mediaType,bytes,submissionHash and producing Branch/job/result/revision. File SHA-256 differs from manifest keccak256. Writer honesty/availability remain trust assumptions; hashes do not prove quality/input consumption.

ASSETS: bounded sorted canonical assetKey table; one accepted main file per slot, one predeclared target changes per round; all other descriptors/provenance remain identical without model re-emission. Latest job orders execution; assets may originate in older rounds. Permanent per-revision checkpoints bind chain/Factory/Branch/policy/revision/source; calldata/events allow public witness reconstruction. Factory.fork authenticates registered parent's chosen checkpoint/full witness, inherits exactly that historical asset set/provenance, fixes child direction. No copying proposals/project IDs/publication names/authority; no recursive ancestry or latest-only fake history.

LIMITS: candidates 16 assets/8 inputs/1 output, 64 KiB document/2 MiB HTML; measure/fix safe constants and disclose restrictions. Reserve one slot per enabled type; at capacity existing updatable slots still update. Bound all fields/parser resources; runtime request bodies <=16,384 UTF-8 bytes. Reject known overlimits before payment; no implicit deletion/unbounded loops.

PROFILES: implement/test Markdown create/update, self-contained HTML create/update, single image generation; no all-stub/all-disabled A1. Explicit runtime steps[].inputs carry full authenticated descriptors/unique aliases at .imd/reads/artifacts/<alias>; selected current assets only, update target mandatory. Fix skill/output/MIME/size/create/update/input-type/publish rules in encoder. Unsupported image reference/editing modes disabled; stored unselected files not falsely claimed read.

HTML: accepted named HTML equals dist/index.html bytes; inline CSS/JS/small PNG/JPEG/WebP. Restore selected HTML, not stale workspace; dist only index.html, no symlinks. Candidate images <=256 KiB each/512 KiB aggregate; count Base64/data-URI overhead within HTML cap and reject known invalid input before payment. HTML -> image -> HTML: third parent is second job, inputs first HTML plus second image; retain old markers and exact inline image bytes. Profiles use github:true, nonwebsite ipfs:false. Publishing defaults off and unverified modes disabled in fixed release config. File/Git/publication states stay separate; live compatibility remains NOT_RUN.

SDK/CLI: six functions, previews, canonical witnesses, prepared proposal/sponsor/retry/bind transactions, history recovery and actual file SHA-256/length/MIME checks. Default unsigned; no real keys/wallets, mandatory server/signer/indexer. Separate transaction/admission/execution/callback/binding/file/Git/publication. Reconcile unknown transactions, never rebuy automatically. Inputs untrusted; no local/private-network downloads or file execution. No browser preview.

TEST/DELIVERY: execute each step's local tests and independent review. Unresolved Critical/High or core failures block readiness. Deliver public source, ABI/config, CLI, raw evidence, measured limits and live-validation tools. Local mocks are not real IMD consumption or deployment proof.
